llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define scroll-vs-swipe arbitration with `react-native-gesture-handler` by creating a `Gesture.Native()` scroll gesture and wiring it to row pan via explicit external-gesture relation APIs (for example `simultaneousWithExternalGesture` or `requireExternalGestureToFail`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No Gesture.Native() scroll gesture is created, and no simultaneousWithExternalGesture or requireExternalGestureToFail call is present. The pan gesture is used standalone inside a plain ScrollView with no explicit arbitration wiring.
evidence: panGesture is constructed with only .activeOffsetX, .failOffsetY, .onStart, .onUpdate, .onEnd — no Native() gesture, no external-gesture relation API

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement swipe handling with `Gesture.Pan()` and `GestureDetector` using current builder callbacks (`onBegin`/`onUpdate`/`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Swipe handling uses Gesture.Pan() wrapped in GestureDetector with builder-style callbacks onStart/onUpdate/onEnd. No useAnimatedGestureHandler is present anywhere in the file.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Pan `onUpdate` must bound horizontal translation with an explicit clamp path (for example `clamp(...)` or equivalent min/max logic) before assigning the row translate shared value.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onUpdate only guards against positive translationX with an if-check (allowing only leftward swipe) but applies no upper bound clamp — translateX.value is assigned raw event.translationX with no Math.max/Math.min/clamp to cap it at ROW_OPEN_OFFSET.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure `Gesture.Pan().activeOffsetX(...)` with explicit numeric thresholds so horizontal movement is required before swipe activation.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: activeOffsetX is configured with explicit symmetric numeric thresholds [14, -14], requiring horizontal movement before pan activates.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure `Gesture.Pan().failOffsetY(...)` with explicit numeric thresholds so vertical movement fails pan and hands interaction back to scroll.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: failOffsetY is configured with explicit symmetric numeric thresholds [-10, 10], so vertical movement beyond ±10px fails the pan and defers to scroll.
